## DEC-05-001 — Choose a candidate generation strategy

decision · domain 05 · [DEC-05-001 — Choose a candidate generation strategy](../../decisions/candidate-strategy.md)

Choose how to expose plausible record pairs to downstream comparison without exhausting the admissible pair space. Compare exact keys, complementary passes, and approximate retrieval families using coverage, skew, cost, and source compatibility. Requires explicit identity semantics, permitted source pairs, and a way to investigate missed matches. Candidate admission is not a match decision; budgets and filtering can undo the coverage benefits of broader retrieval.

Tags: `blocking`, `candidate-generation`, `entity-agnostic`, `evaluation`, `high-recall`, `low-cost`, `source-aware`.

## SOL-05-001 — Exact-key blocking

solution · domain 05 · [SOL-05-001 — Exact-key blocking](../../solutions/candidate-generation/exact-blocking.md)

Admit record pairs that share a declared blocking key, using equality on a single attribute or a composite of attributes. This creates an interpretable candidate baseline when key values are available, stable, and comparable across sources. Requires explicit normalization, missing-value handling, and identifier semantics. The main risks are complete exclusion after key errors and candidate explosion from common values; equality proposes comparison, not identity.

## SOL-05-002 — Multi-pass blocking and candidate union

solution · domain 05 · [SOL-05-002 — Multi-pass blocking and candidate union](../../solutions/candidate-generation/multi-pass-blocking.md)

Combine candidate sets from distinct blocking or retrieval passes so that different attributes and representations can expose different matching pairs. Requires stable pair identity, pass provenance, explicit eligibility rules, and evaluation beyond the original candidate set. An uncapped union preserves prior pair coverage, but overlapping passes add work without necessarily adding matches. Global caps, routing, or filtering can break that guarantee and change the downstream evidence distribution.

## SOL-05-003 — Approximate retrieval under explicit candidate budgets

solution · domain 05 · [SOL-05-003 — Approximate retrieval under explicit candidate budgets](../../solutions/candidate-generation/approximate-blocking.md)

Compare sorted neighborhoods, shingle indexes, canopy prefilters, MinHash/LSH and bounded vector retrieval against exact and multi-pass blocking. Preserve representation, admission and truncation provenance. Requires a declared pair universe, cost budget and independent missed-match evidence. Approximate mechanisms tolerate different errors but can lose matches through keys, similarity mismatch, skew or caps. Measure a coverage–cost frontier rather than equate more candidates with more true matches; retrieved similarity is not identity and filter guarantees need their exact predicate assumptions.

Tags: `blocking`, `candidate-generation`, `experimentation`, `high-recall`, `large-scale`, `multi-pass`, `noisy`, `uncertainty`.
